description_en: Queries the health status of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDBClusterHealthStatus接口查看数仓版集群的健康状态
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-health-status --db-cluster-id am-bp1d8lbdj22rx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterHealthStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a specific region

数仓版集群ID。

parameters.help_en:
